title: glab api projects/${project}/releases?per_page=${n} [--paginate]
description: The project's releases, newest first, ${project} its path URL-encoded: every one, per_page=100 with --paginate, which prints one such array per page, which kit draws as the releases stage's in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:releases, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::gitlab_releases), and the newest, per_page=1, whose tag_name and released_at make a mark (forge/gitlab:marks, with forge::gitlab_marks). The types are APIEntitiesRelease of GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/releases in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, as https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/ describes them.

upcoming_release.description: True when released_at is in the future.
